gun-violence.name: Gun violence
gun-violence.line: I worry about people getting shot where I live.

sources.passage: GUN Gun violence Jan 27-Feb 2, 2025 48 29 18 4 *
All firearm deaths Number of deaths: 44,447 Deaths per 100,000 population: 13.1

gun-violence.prevalence: In early 2025, 48% of U.S. adults called gun violence a very big problem (Pew). 44,447 people died from firearms in the U.S. in the latest year of CDC data.

school-shootings.name: School shootings
school-shootings.line: I worry that a shooting could happen at my kids' school.

sources.passage: Roughly a third of parents with K-12 students (32%) said they were extremely or very worried
a majority of public K-12 teachers (59%) say they are at least somewhat worried
Often Worry Crimes Child Harmed at School Table Frequently Occasionally Rarely Never Does not apply (vol.) No opinion % % % % % % 2025 Oct 1-16 25 18 19 22 15 1

school-shootings.prevalence: 32% of U.S. parents of K-12 students are extremely or very worried about a shooting at their child's school, and 59% of public school teachers are at least somewhat worried (Pew). In 2025, 25% of U.S. adults frequently worried about a child being harmed at school (Gallup).

road-deaths.name: Traffic deaths
road-deaths.line: I worry about people getting killed or badly hurt on the roads around here.

sources.passage: Approximately 1.16 million people die each year as a result of road traffic crashes.
In 2023, 16% of adults worldwide named road-related accidents as the greatest source of risk in their life
Over three in four adults worldwide (76%) say they are very or somewhat worried about being harmed in a road accident
Motor vehicle traffic deaths Number of deaths: 41,241 Deaths per 100,000 population: 12.1

road-deaths.prevalence: About 1.16 million people die in road crashes each year (WHO). In 2023, 16% of adults worldwide named road accidents as the biggest risk in their life, the top answer, and 76% were worried about being harmed on the road (World Risk Poll). 41,241 people died in U.S. traffic in the latest year of CDC data.

terrorism.name: Terrorism
terrorism.line: I worry about attacks meant to kill and frighten people.

sources.passage: ITERR International terrorism Jan 27-Feb 2, 2025 36 38 22 3 1
DTERR Domestic terrorism Jan 27-Feb 2, 2025 34 38 24 3 1
Rise of extremism Terrorism

terrorism.prevalence: In early 2025, 36% of U.S. adults called international terrorism and 34% domestic terrorism a very big problem (Pew). Ipsos tracks terrorism and the rise of extremism as national worries.

violence-against-women.name: Violence against women
violence-against-women.line: I see women and girls hurt by men, often by someone they know.

sources.passage: about 1 in 3 (31.6%) of women worldwide (840 million women and girls) have been subjected to either physical and/or sexual
on average 140 women and girls were killed every day by their partner or other family members globally

violence-against-women.prevalence: About 1 in 3 women worldwide (31.6%, 840 million) have faced physical or sexual violence; on average 140 women and girls a day were killed by a partner or family member (WHO).

elder-abuse.name: Elder abuse
elder-abuse.line: I worry about older people being hurt, neglected or cheated by people they trust.

sources.passage: Around 1 in 6 people 60 years and older experienced some form of abuse in community settings during the past year.

elder-abuse.prevalence: Around 1 in 6 people aged 60 and older experienced some form of abuse in the past year (WHO).

trafficking.name: Trafficking
trafficking.line: I know people are still being trafficked, forced to work or forced to marry.

sources.passage: Fifty million people were living in modern slavery in 2021
28 million were in forced labour
An estimated 22 million people were living in forced marriage on any given day in 2021.

trafficking.prevalence: Fifty million people were living in modern slavery in 2021: 28 million in forced labor and 22 million in forced marriage (ILO, Walk Free, IOM).

unsafe-food.name: Unsafe food
unsafe-food.line: I worry the food I buy could make my family sick.

sources.passage: An estimated 866 million – almost 1 in 9 people in the world – fall ill after eating contaminated food
Food 21 37 59

unsafe-food.prevalence: About 866 million people, almost 1 in 9, fall ill each year from contaminated food (WHO). 59% of adults worldwide were worried that food could seriously harm them (World Risk Poll).
